about_short_description.short_description: Resquared offers a SaaS application that works as a marketing automation platform for selling to local businesses.

product.name: Local Business Database
product.description: A database containing contact and business information on over 12 million local businesses in the US and Canada, enabling targeted prospecting.

product.name: Email Prospecting
product.description: A tool for sending personalized, AI-assisted email campaigns directly to local business owners to initiate sales outreach.

product.name: Sales Pipeline Management
product.description: A system to organize, track, and manage sales prospects and deals throughout the sales process.

product.name: Outreach Analytics
product.description: An analytics dashboard that tracks and reports on outreach activities, engagement rates, and sales performance metrics.

product.name: Social Media Outreach
product.description: A tool to send messages directly to local businesses via their social media accounts such as Facebook Messenger and Instagram Messenger.
